name: Priscilla
summary: The wife of Aquila, who with him worked alongside Paul as a tentmaker in Corinth. With her husband she explained God's way more fully to Apollos, and a church met in their home.

key_moments.title: Making Tents with Paul
key_moments.description: Priscilla and her husband Aquila had come from Italy after Claudius ordered all Jews out of Rome. In Corinth Paul stayed and worked with them, for they were tentmakers as he was.

key_moments.title: Setting Out with Paul
key_moments.description: After staying many days, Paul sailed for Syria with Priscilla and Aquila. At Ephesus he left the couple there.

key_moments.title: Teaches Apollos the Way of God
key_moments.description: When Priscilla and Aquila heard Apollos preach at Ephesus, knowing only John's baptism, they took him aside. They explained God's way to him more perfectly.
